name: io.github.leogaudin/opencaptions
title: OpenCaptions
description: Animated word-by-word captions for your videos, on your computer or your own OpenCaptions server

environmentVariables.name: OPENCAPTIONS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An API key from your OpenCaptions server's Account page, to caption there. Without it the package captions on this computer, with FFmpeg.

environmentVariables.name: OPENCAPTIONS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your OpenCaptions server's web address (http://localhost:5173 when only the key is set)
